authority_basis.principle: Freeze the history-window methodology entirely on pre-2025 evidence; open locked 2025 only after freeze; do not retune after seeing 2025.
authority_basis.pooling: NOT_AUTHORIZED under V1 because a robust single memory regime was found

rationale: Pre-2025 robustness identified one contiguous stable band, 475-550 observations.
All four band members improved both MSE and QLIKE versus expanding in 2022, 2023 and 2024.
W=500 is frozen as a deterministic operational representative of the approximately-500-observation plateau, not selected from 2025 and not because a single-point optimum is being claimed.
The remaining band members are sensitivity checks only and cannot replace W=500 after locked-2025 results are observed.

primary_transport_label_rule.supportive: W500 has MSE <= expanding AND QLIKE <= expanding AND AUC >= expanding - 0.02 AND produces at least one high-risk alarm.
primary_transport_label_rule.mixed: The supportive rule is not fully met, but W500 does not have both MSE and QLIKE worse than expanding and does not collapse to zero alarms.
primary_transport_label_rule.not_supportive: W500 has both MSE > expanding AND QLIKE > expanding, OR produces zero high-risk alarms.

band_robustness_rule.supportive: At least 3 of 4 frozen band members satisfy the primary supportive rule against expanding.
band_robustness_rule.mixed: Exactly 2 of 4 satisfy the primary supportive rule.
band_robustness_rule.not_supportive: At most 1 of 4 satisfies the primary supportive rule.

locked_2025_transport_contract.note: These transport labels are preregistered now, before any locked-2025 evaluation under this frozen policy.

forbidden_after_2025_open: choosing the best 2025 band member as the new primary
